about: Chapter 1: the prize email on the laptop (evidence_table `screen`); the prize line rolls through the three accounts' versions. The push runs from the whole laptop screen (zoom 1.4) to the prize line (3.2, 1.83x the old 1.75): at the end its cap height is about 46 px and it spans about 64 % of the width, its start at 29 %, and the left edge keeps a sliver of the laptop: the bezel's dark band and the lid's edge glint, the display's edge about 72 px in. One eased path: both ends are allowed framings, so the centre moves on one straight line (the start used to sit outside the plate's crop and the clamp held it, then let go: a 2.4 px/frame drift that stopped dead at 0.46 s). Review 10 (fault 13): the invented supporting lines were readable on a phone. The prize line is now the only sharp line: the focus sits on it (focus_uv v 0.4405, its glyphs' centre, was 0.45; start_center and end_offset re-solved so the camera path is the same to 0.1 px) with a shallow depth of field, sharp within 0.6 em and fully soft 2.2 em further, its blur growing with the push (zoom_scaled: 7.9 px at the start, 18 px at the end, the same against the text's size). In screen.html the supporting lines are a softer grey and the prize line stands as its own paragraph, about 2.4 lines clear of its neighbours (was 1.7 and 2.1), so they get 82 % of the full blur (about 15 px at the end) while the fall-off stays gentle enough that the sidebar's edge and the bezel do not show a hard sharp slot around the line (a 1.2 em ramp did). The rest reads as rows of a letter, not words, at full size and at 480x270; the prize line and its roll keep their size.
